title: Annex A.9 - Use of AI systems
description: Working paper for Annex A.9: responsible use process, intended use, monitoring use.

sections.title: Responsible use process (A.9.2)
prompts: Confirm a documented responsible-use process and approval gate before deployment.
Verify acceptable use policy is communicated to users / operators.

sections.title: Intended use of AI systems (A.9.3)
prompts: Confirm intended-use definition is documented per system.
Verify out-of-scope use is detected (sample monitoring data).

sections.title: Monitoring of AI system use (A.9.4)
prompts: Confirm controls to detect misuse / off-spec usage.

checklists.text: Acceptable-use policy exists and is enforced.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: How do you detect a customer using your system out-of-spec?
Show us an alert that fired and the response taken.
